chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: Commuting from Boston on the 12:05 train
summary: Musicians worked in Boston but returned to New York each weekend.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: See, all of us used to come home at
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
12:05. Nobody stayed in Boston. All the musicians would come down on the 12:05. Everybody worked in Boston, but came back over the weekend.

The train would leave the main station and get to Back Bay 12:05 minutes later. Everybody was rushing to get that train to get back to New York. Then we'd (Inaudible) come back to Boston like five o'clock in the afternoon, you know, just in time to go to work -- get straightened out. So that's what happened.
